Battlefield Dominance.text: Mirror T&H. Rounds 1-2: majority of objectives at the end of turn. Round 2+: score per objective controlled at the end of Command phase, bonus for central objective.

Determined Acquisition.text: T&H vs Disruption. Score for each newly-seized objective every turn, then per objective controlled at the end of Command phase with a bonus in enemy territory.

Immovable Object.text: T&H vs Purge. Holding the central objective pays every turn. Rounds 2-4: per objective controlled at the end of Command phase. Round 5: switches to end of turn.

Inescapable Dominion.text: T&H vs Priority Assets. Holding 3+ objectives scores every turn. Round 2+: holding 2+ is the baseline, beating your opponent adds a bonus.

Purge and Secure.text: T&H vs Recon. Killing while on an objective scores. Round 2+: per objective controlled at the end of Command phase plus a bonus for seizing a new objective.

Death Trap.text: Disruption vs T&H. Trapping terrain outside your zone scores, bonus if it's an objective. Killing in trapped terrain scores separately. Round 2+: hold outside home.

Outmanoeuvre.text: Mirror Disruption. Early: per objective at end of turn. Mid: end of Command phase (bigger). Final rounds: back to end of turn at maximum. Opponent's home = 10 VP.

Delaying Action.text: Disruption vs Purge. Score per enemy unit destroyed. Round 2+: hold outside home at the end of Command phase, bonus for covering both central and expansion objectives.

Locate and Deny.text: Disruption vs Priority Assets. Mark 5 terrain areas. Your opponent removes the markers. Score for destroying in marked terrain, for holding the last marked one. Round 2+: hold outside home.

Smoke and Mirrors.text: Disruption vs Recon. Actions on non-home objectives to Decoy them. Score per Decoyed objective, bonus in enemy territory. End: big bonus if 4+ are still Decoyed.

Unstoppable Force.text: Purge vs T&H. Killing scores every turn. Round 2+: per objective controlled at the end of Command phase, bonus for seizing a new objective. End: central objective bonus.

Punishment.text: Purge vs Disruption. Designate Condemned units. Destroying them scores at the end of turn. Round 2+: hold outside home with a majority bonus. End: seize the opponent's home.

Meatgrinder.text: Mirror Purge. Killing scores every turn. Round 2+: non-home objective at the end of Command phase, beating the opponent's kill count adds a bonus, holding the opponent's home scores every turn.

Destroyer's Wrath.text: Purge vs Priority Assets. Score per unit destroyed every turn. Round 2+: control outside home plus a majority bonus, rewarded for beating the opponent's kill count.

Consecrate.text: Purge vs Recon. Killing on a non-home objective Consecrates it. Scores in tiers (1-2 or 3+ Consecrated). Round 2+: standard control in parallel. End: opponent's home Consecrated.

Secure Asset.text: Priority Assets vs T&H. Actions on non-home objectives AND kills in no man's land both score. Round 2+: per objective held at the end of Command phase, large-board bonus (3+).

Extract Relic.text: Priority Assets vs Disruption. Actions on central objectives to un-mark them. One action per turn scores. Round 2+: control outside home. End: hold the last marked one.

Vital Link.text: Priority Assets vs Purge. Holding central objectives scores, bonus if an action was performed on them. Round 2+: any objective outside home, bonus if central. End: opponent's home.

Sabotage.text: Mirror Priority Assets. Sabotaging non-home objectives scores, bonus in enemy territory. Round 2+: standard control outside home completes the scoring.

Vanguard Operation.text: Priority Assets vs Recon. Actions in enemy territory for a Vanguard Operation, bonus for killing that same turn. Round 2+: control outside home. End: opponent's home objective.

Reconnaissance Sweep.text: Recon vs T&H. 3 quarters = 3 VP, 4 quarters = 6 VP (only the highest counts). No Prisoners: VP per unit destroyed. Round 2+: objective control at the end of Command phase.

Surveil the Foe.text: Recon vs Disruption. Spot enemy units within 18". Score for units Spotted on non-Decoyed objectives, control outside home from round 2+ with a majority bonus.

Triangulation.text: Recon vs Purge. Round 2+: one action per turn to Triangulate an objective. Scores in tiers (1, 2, 3+ - only the highest counts). Standard control in parallel. End: 4+ objectives.

Search and Scour.text: Recon vs Priority Assets. Holding a central objective AND killing from a terrain area both score. Round 2+: control outside home. End: no enemy unit in your territory.

Gather Intel.text: Mirror Recon. Round 1: central objective. Round 2+: control outside home plus a reward scaled by actions performed. End: 3+ Marked and opponent's home Marked.
